description:
Standalone cross-platform desktop app for SFMC Data Extension export/import.

A standalone desktop application that wraps the sfmc-dataloader CLI to make exporting and importing Salesforce Marketing Cloud Data Extensions easy, without needing to install Node.js or use the command line.
## Bugfixes

• Improve dialog text contrast and keep release-note links readable and underlined, including visited links.
• Simplify the update dialog title to **What's new** and exclude all update-summary releases from **Release history**.
• Display offline release notes with Markdown formatting. Raw HTML is escaped and images are disabled; credential-free HTTPS links open only in your system browser. Notes still come from the bundled changelog, without runtime fetching.

The bundled transfer engine is unchanged：`sfmc-dataloader` 4.0.0 and parser 5.0.0.

See the [versioned changelog](https://github.com/JoernBerkefeld/sfmc-dataloader-app/blob/v0.8.1/CHANGELOG.md) for details.

**Full Changelog**：https://github.com/JoernBerkefeld/sfmc-dataloader-app/compare/v0.8.0...v0.8.1
